statement: For generic symmetric couplings and frequencies, an N-vertex tree has 2^(N−1) complex equilibria and an N-cycle has N·binom(N−1,floor((N−1)/2)).

source.location: Theorem 3.5 and Table 3.1 (printed pp.7–10), tree and cycle rows
source.version: arXiv:1708.09246v1, 30 August 2017; genericity comparison arXiv:2210.00784v3, 25 September 2024; inspected 2026-11-04

scope: N≥2 for trees and N≥3 for cycles; complex torus solutions with one reference phase fixed.
notes:
The later genericity theorem justifies specializing the adjacency-polytope volume to symmetric couplings.

The following bibliography supplies historical attribution or supporting background for the result. Tianran Chen, Robert Davis, Dhagash Mehta, Counting equilibria of the Kuramoto model using birationally invariant intersection index (2017, chen_2017_kuramoto_intersection).

The generic symmetric-coupling count is recorded against Chen–Korchevskaia–Lindberg. Chen–Davis–Mehta, Theorems 8, 11, 14 and 15, gives the earlier tree and cycle analysis at https://arxiv.org/pdf/1708.09246v1.
